delivery.outcome: Publish new-project 0.20.1 with managed local Subactor storage, work-continuity v2 and network-free local pin enforcement.
nonGoals: Do not fetch or mutate repository state from pre-commit
Do not impose a policy size cap on append-only session event streams
Do not treat checkpoint data or prose as execution or merge authority
Do not modify the user-owned untracked fixture in the primary checkout
Do not merge or publish this pull request

architecture.decision: Keep authoritative Git, intent, lease and protected receipts outside model prose; store unlimited append-only local events in ignored .subactor runtime paths, derive a bounded atomic latest-checkpoint index, and validate the already-adopted immutable standard pin locally at commit time.
interfaceChanges: Managed local storage exposes tracked .subactor/manifest.json and six ignored runtime directories
Work continuity advances to v2 with exact plan, slice, Git, lease, remote/account and snapshot bindings
Managed pre-commit rejects local standard-pin drift without network or mutation
dataChanges: Local continuity storage changes from an unbounded checkpoint registry to append-only events plus a bounded index
New-project release projections advance from 0.20.0 to 0.20.1
architecture.rollback: Before publication revert the atomic ticket commit; after publication issue a newer corrective standard and preserve append-only events and unknown snapshots for manual recovery.

validation.evidence: Scratch repositories prove v2 bindings, append-only events, bounded atomic index and divergence handling.
Adopter hook validates only local managed data and explicit adoption supplies freshness.

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
validation.evidence: Complete deterministic suite and exact-head governance pass.
